በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ለንግሥት: ንግሥት — to the queen (ለ- + noun, fem.)
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
ርቱዕ: ርቱዕ — right, fitting (adjective, used as predicate)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom')
ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · also the verb ገብረ: he did, made (3ms perfect, g-b-r; ገብረ ሠናየ 'he did good')
ሰማየ: ሰማይ — heaven (noun, accusative of place 'in heaven')
ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land')
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ይደሉ: ደለወ — it is fitting, due (3m sg imperfect, d-l-w)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
እግዚአ: እግዚእ — lord (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
በምክረ: ምክር — by the counsel of (በ- + construct)
አውረደ: አውረደ — he brought down (3ms perfect, causative of ወረደ)
ፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — his judgment (noun, accusative ፍትሐ + -ሁ '3ms his')
ወትቤ: ይቤ — and she said (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of defective ይቤ)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ወአስምዐኒ: አስምዐ — and he made me hear (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ሰምዐ + -ኒ '1cs me')
ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-) · plain 'his wisdom' with no ለ- phrase following (ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom')
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs')
ወይነግራ: ነገረ — and he tells her (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G + -ኣ 'her')
ወይእቲኒ: ይእቲ — and she also (ወ- + 3fs pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
እምፈተውኩ: ፈተወ — if I wished (እም- 'if', though 'rather than' is possible, + 1cs perfect, G) (?)
እንበር: ነበረ — that I stay, dwell (1cs subjunctive, G, n-b-r)
እፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — I desire, wish (1cs imperfect, G)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ልበ: ልብ — heart (construct 'heart of') · accusative 'the heart' (ያስተፈሥሕ ልበ 'it gladdens the heart')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
ጥበቦ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem., accusative + -ኦ '3ms his')
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix)
ወያነክር: አነከረ — and he marvelled (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative, 'wonder, marvel'; narrative use)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people')
ትሖር: ሖረ — that she go (3fs, after ከመ; the imperfect shape ትሖር)
እምአጽናፈ: ጽንፍ — from the ends of (እም- 'from' + plural አጽናፍ, construct)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest')
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
ለለ: ለለ — each, every (distributive); uncertain in this context (see note on ተረፈ) · certain as the distributive 'each' (ለለ አሐቲ ጊዜ 'each single time')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
ለእለ: እለ — to those who (ለ- 'to' + relative pronoun pl.) · ለ- marking the object: 'those who' (ያአምር ለእለ ስሕቱ 'he discerns those who have erred')
ሎሙ: ለ — to them (preposition ለ- with 3mp suffix: ሎሙ)
ዘበሰማያት: ሰማይ — which (is) in the heavens (ዘ- relative + በ- + plural ሰማያት)
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate) · attributive after an accusative noun (ሞገሰ ብዙኀ 'abundant grace')
ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (construct 'sin of') · also accusative, object: ገብረ ኀጢአተ 'he does sin'
ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
